liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (3 reviews): Reviewer notes this was the first Foolish Heart, and recalls gooney bird acid being around in the lot at their first show; Reviewer says it was the first ever Foolish Heart [16][23][24]
- **Space** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer hears something like the band Yes being said during Space around 1:25 on track 13, unintelligible; A 21-second patch in Space comes from a Sennheiser 421 source [5][20]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): After 48 seconds of tuning, the opener is not great but flows well, segueing smoothly into Stranger [21]
- **Bird Song** (1 other source): Bird Song was patched using a Sennheiser 421 source supplied by Lucien Zaleski and Alex Ford [3]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-06-19.151045.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 146 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-06-19.sbd.miller.95920.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 146 min; rated 3.6/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard is a welcome improvement after twenty years of a poor-sounding audience copy [24]
- **gd1988-06-19.151602.UltraMatrix.sbd.1stGen.repatched.voss.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 146 min [3]
- **gd1988-06-19.172968.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 148 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd88-06-19.sennheiser.ladner.17267.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 144 min; rated 3.73/5 by 15 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording lacking in quality and wishes for a soundboard; Audience recording is cloudy and only slightly better than the previous show's recording; Reviewer rates the audience recording B quality, not great, but it conveys the enthusiasm of the Alpine crowd [20][21][23]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the sheets of blotter acid were circulating throughout the whole tour, and they kept using them into winter [14]
- Black Pyramid blotter circulated on Shakedown; reviewer took it, saw lightning in trees, missed the show, danced in the parking lot for a day [18]
- Reviewer recalls a hot, dusty midwest drought summer, an army tent, tequila shots handed out, and four shows with a Wednesday break [19]
- Reviewer recalls a nitrous tank in the bathroom stall stage left and parking along the highway before the show [20]
- First of four shows in southern Wisconsin, roughly 75 minutes from metropolitan Chicago [21]
- Reviewer describes the show as the first voyage of their VW camper [23]
- Kreutzmann gave the crowd a pep talk before the show, asking them to be cool [1]
- Kreutzmann gave the crowd a pep talk before the show, asking them to be cool [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-06-19.151045.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Jim Voss who copied Don Pearson's masters after the show; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 3, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) > Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S) [1]
- **gd1988-06-19.sbd.miller.95920.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony D5/Dolby B) [2]. Also: Sennheiser 441 cassette master transferred to DAT then CD; pitch correction was done with Joe B. Jobes's help [2]
- **gd1988-06-19.151602.UltraMatrix.sbd.1stGen.repatched.voss.miller.t.flac16**: taped by John Voss; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 16, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) > Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S) [3]. Also: Upgraded re-patched version of an earlier release; Jim Voss recorded it, copying Don Pearson's masters after the show [3]
- **gd1988-06-19.172968.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Beyer M160 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [5]
- **gd88-06-19.sennheiser.ladner.17267.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Craig Camus; source: Audience [8]
